items.title: From Projects to Products: Turning Platforms into Products People Use
items.summaryShort: From Projects to Products: Turning Platforms into Products People Use. Having a platform is not enough; the real challenge is ensuring that it is understandable, usable, and actually adopted by its users.

items.title: Presentation: From ms to µs: OSS Valkey Architecture Patterns for Modern AI
items.summaryShort: Presentation: From ms to µs: OSS Valkey Architecture Patterns for Modern AI. Dumanshu Goyal discusses optimizing data layers for low-latency workloads like AI feature stores.

items.title: Wiz Discloses CosmosEscape, and Practitioners Debate What Customers Could Have Done
items.summaryShort: Wiz Discloses CosmosEscape, and Practitioners Debate What Customers Could Have Done. Wiz Research disclosed CosmosEscape, a chain that escaped Azure Cosmos DB's Gremlin sandbox and reached a platform-wide key granting read and write access

items.title: Article: Runtime-Agnostic AI Workflows: A Pattern for Production Durability and Fast Eval Iteration
items.summaryShort: Article: Runtime-Agnostic AI Workflows: A Pattern for Production Durability and Fast Eval Iteration. AI workflows have two needs that trade off directly.

items.title: Pods as Workers, Not Agents: Rethinking the Deployment Unit for AI Agents on Kubernetes
items.summaryShort: Pods as Workers, Not Agents: Rethinking the Deployment Unit for AI Agents on Kubernetes. Running AI agents on Kubernetes raises a key question: should each agent get its own Pod?

items.title: eBay continues to bet on live shopping after record quarter
items.summaryShort: eBay continues to bet on live shopping after record quarter. eBay touted an increase in eBay Live's gross merchandise volume as it plans to expand it to more international markets in the coming weeks and months.

items.title: Amid legal battles, Suno says it will start watermarking songs
items.summaryShort: Amid legal battles, Suno says it will start watermarking songs. Suno's watermarking feature comes as the company is fighting legal battles on several fronts.

items.title: Ford's new electric truck, ‘Fathom', starts at $28,350
items.summaryShort: Ford's new electric truck, ‘Fathom', starts at $28,350. Due in "fall 2027," Ford said Thursday that it won't reveal what Fathom looks like until early next year.
